spans.s: munigāthā, pl. (Aśokan id., 〔Bhabra 5〕), n. of a Buddhist text, doubtless = Pali Munisutta, Sn vss 〔207—221〕: Divy 〔20.24〕; 〔35.1〕.
Munipravara, n. of a former Buddha: Mv 〔iii.230.15〕.
Munihata, m., n. of King Bandhuma(nt)ʼs pleasure-park: Mv 〔ii.273.9〕.
Munīndrā, n. of a kiṃnara maid: Kv 〔6.21〕.
